note: Historic CCC-built campground, on the National Register of Historic Places, among tall pines and hemlocks on 892-acre Franklin Lake: sandy beach, boat landing open to all boats, two log picnic pavilions. Two loops about 1 km apart along the shore; the lakeside sites see the water through a line of trees. Trails start in the campground, including a 6-mile hike to Anvil Lake. --Claude
